comment_regular: Recursively searches an Actor scene subtree for an admissible collision-backed embed node. It filters collision layer/body groups, ray-tests the supplied start/direction against each candidate, updates inOutDistance to the accepted fraction, and returns the selected NiAVObject; no bone name is hard-coded.
